title: feat(types): declare node-level `responsiveStyles` on `flex`, `object-grid` and `object-chart`, by reference to the spec (objectui#10872, batch 9)
body:
Part of #10872
Clause-②: yes

Batch 9 of objectui#10872. It declares the node-level `responsiveStyles` that `@objectstack/spec`'s `PageComponentSchema` declares on every page component on the three arms outside the public-block set that a producer writes it on: `flex`, `object-grid` and `object-chart`. The declaration is by reference to the spec, from batch 8's fragment. Claim `5918816527`, seat `domain:ui#1`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`.

**Clause-② yes (widening).** The strict authoring face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`) now accepts a spec-valid node-level `responsiveStyles` on `FlexSchema`, `ObjectGridSchema` and `ObjectChartSchema`. Before, it refused the key by name. Changeset: `.changeset/10872-flat-arm-responsive-styles.md`, `'@object-ui/types': minor`. Unlike batch 8's arms, these three were already published, so the changeset spells out the narrowings too (see Acceptance notes).

## What changed

- **zod.** `FlexSchema` (`layout.zod.ts`), `ObjectGridSchema` and `ObjectChartSchema` (`objectql.zod.ts`) spread the same fragment the 30 public-block arms spread. The member is ONE object on all 33 arms: the spec's `ResponsiveStylesSchema` through the objectui#8317 boundary. `BaseSchema` is not touched, and neither is any other arm.
- **The fragment is renamed from `PUBLIC_BLOCK_ENVELOPE` to `NODE_ENVELOPE`.** It stays in `public-blocks.zod.ts`, because that module imports only `base.zod.ts`, `imported-defaults.ts` and `tombstone.zod.ts`, so neither import makes a cycle. With `flex` spreading it, the old name would tell a reader that `flex` is a public block. The rename is mechanical: 30 occurrences in `public-blocks.zod.ts`, 5 in `objectql.zod.ts`, plus one census row key, one test comment and one README line. On-disk counts were 0 old / 38 new after the rename.
- **TypeScript twins.** `FlexSchema` (`layout.ts`), `ObjectGridSchema` and `ObjectChartSchema` (`objectql.ts`) declare `responsiveStyles?: ResponsiveStyles`, the spec's type by reference (type-only import, as `dataSource?: ElementDataSource` already is). It is not on `FlexLayoutProps`, so `stack` does not gain it.
- **`object-view`'s `table` slot does not gain the key.** The slot is built from `ObjectGridSchema`'s shape, so the zod change alone would have made `table.responsiveStyles` accepted and judged, where nothing compiles it: `ObjectView` draws its grid as a component. The slot now refuses it by name, as it refuses the other node-level keys (objectui#10976). The reason is its own, not the shared node-level one, because that one points the author at the `object-view` node, whose arm does not declare the key either.
- **Pins.** New: `packages/types/src/__tests__/flat-arm-responsive-styles-10872.test.ts`, with 37 runtime rows and 3 type-level assertion groups. Forced edits to existing pins:
  - batch 8's pin: its boundary control moves from `flex` to `grid`;
  - `object-view-slot-key-lists.test.ts`: the grid's member count goes from 63 to 64, and `responsiveStyles` joins the `nodeLevel` withheld set;
  - `stack-schema-emitted-members.test.ts`: `stack` declares exactly `flex`'s members less the named `responsiveStyles`;
  - census text in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` and `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`: the row key follows the rename, and the reason names the three arms. The census reads presence, not words.
- One zod `README.md` line plus the rename in the existing line, and one changeset.

## The order's mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **The pull, re-driven.** objectui `54a78308a3` was read from its tracked files. objectstack `aaad682dbc` (main at 2026-09-30T19:33Z) was read from a depth-1 scratch clone; the shared checkout was not fetched or edited. The instrument is `scripts/body-dialect-census.mjs` (`scanNodes`, `keepFencedCodeOnly`, `bucketOf`) under an uncommitted scratch driver. It counts NODES carrying a node-level `responsiveStyles`, and it reads the arm population at run time from `AnyComponentSchema` (189 literals, 30 of them public-block literals).
   - Non-test producers on arms outside the public-block set: `flex` 16 (showcase `command-center.page.ts` 8 and `styling-gallery.page.ts` 7, plus skill `rules/pages.md` 1), `object-chart` 1 and `object-grid` 1 (both in `command-center.page.ts`). Every other non-public arm: 0. objectui non-test: 0.
   - Lit control: the detector fires on the test buckets, on the same types (objectstack `flex` 11; objectui `flex` 1, `object-chart` 1).
   - **Confirmed**, and the population is exactly these three arms.
2. **The faces at base.** For all three arms, the strict face refused a valid map as `unrecognized_keys` naming `responsiveStyles`. The tolerant face ACCEPTED and kept `7` and `{ md: … }` unjudged. `grid`, `stack` and `container` read the same. **Confirmed.**
3. **Reuse the fragment.** There is no cycle, so the fragment was not moved. It was renamed because the name would lie (see What changed). There is no second copy of the member: the pin asserts identity with `PageSectionBlockSchema.shape.responsiveStyles`.
4. **Flat arms and the TypeScript twins.** Measured with the zod member alone, before any TypeScript edit, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` failed on two census assertions:
   - `assertionMirroredUndeclaredMatchesLedger` named exactly the three pairs (`layout.zod.ts#FlexSchema`, `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectChartSchema`, `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectGridSchema`);
   - `assertionMirroredUndeclaredRecordsEveryKey` named `responsiveStyles`.

   Two edits turn it green: three new `MirroredUndeclared` rows, or the declaration on the twins. That ledger is a floor that "can only shrink", so the declaration was taken, by reference to the spec's type, as the order's item 4 says. It is part of the same widening. Two more consumers read the twins through the compiler and were forced as listed above.
5. **`BaseSchema` stays untouched.** It is not in the diff; the pin asserts that `BaseSchema.shape` lacks the key and that every other arm refuses it. There is no `needs_decision`.

## Evidence

- **Red first**, at base `54a78308a3` with the pin added and the source unmodified. `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 …/flat-arm-responsive-styles-10872.test.ts` gave `Tests  17 failed | 20 passed (37)`. The 17 reds:
  - 3 member-identity rows, the spec-map row and the arm-population row;
  - 3 valid-node rows (strict face `unrecognized_keys`);
  - 9 invalid-value rows (tolerant face accepted, expected the spec's issue).

  The 20 controls (population, lit control, `grid` / `stack` / `container`, and the other five envelope keys) were green. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` at base gave 8 errors: TS2339 on the three zod shapes, and TS2344 `Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'` on the three TypeScript-twin assertions.
- **Ablation**, at `c4edd1d106` with the implementation committed first. It ran three single-arm legs through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, plus a shell trap restoring both zod files by absolute path. Each leg deleted one arm's spread, and each anchor hit exactly once:
  - `flex` leg: blob `797a9c0b4e63` to `6011a4533631`, `Tests  7 failed | 30 passed (37)`;
  - `object-grid` leg: `2aa44c282213` to `1e00d88afe2c`, `6 failed | 31 passed`;
  - `object-chart` leg: `2aa44c282213` to `673ec48085df`, `6 failed | 31 passed`.

  The union of the three is exactly the 17 red-first rows. Every restore read `ok restored: blob == HEAD … git diff HEAD is empty`, and the final check read both blobs equal to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` at 0 bytes. The pin imports `../zod/index.zod.js` from source, so there is no dist leg.
- **Reverse type check**, through the rebuilt `dist`. A scratch consumer in `packages/components` resolved `@object-ui/types` to `packages/types/dist/index.d.ts` (`--traceResolution`). It got exactly 3 errors, one per bad line: TS2353 `'md' does not exist`, TS2559 for a number, and TS2322 for a boolean style value. The three valid lines got none. The scratch files were deleted.
- **Runtime probe** (scratch, deleted). Each type was mounted through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry, and each emitted a `style[data-os-scope]` with the base block and the `@media` override:
  - `flex`: the scope class is on the flex root `div`;
  - `object-grid`: on the grid's container `div`, which holds the rows;
  - `object-chart`: on the chart container (`[data-slot="chart"]`), which holds the SVG.

  In each control without the key, 0 style tags were emitted. Declared is enforced on these arms.
- **Final head `c31dff6c1f`**, clean tree, one os-verify-lock hold per step, every VERDICT command-exit 0:
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` gave `dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete`;
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` passed, and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both 10872 pins;
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` gave `Test Files  296 passed (296)` and `Tests  7412 passed (7412)`;
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/` gave `23 passed (23)` and `335 passed (335)`; the registered-types ratchet is unchanged;
  - **the arm-list consumer sweep** ran 162 test files outside `packages/types` and `packages/cli`: every file naming the zod node union, the strict face, `safeValidateSchema`, the `@object-ui/types/zod` entry, an arm `.shape`, or `FlexSchema` / `StackSchema` / `ObjectGridSchema` / `ObjectChartSchema` / `ObjectViewSchema` / `responsiveStyles` / the fragment. It gave `79 passed` with 1537 tests and `83 passed` with 1196 tests;
  - the 24 `scripts/__tests__` files that read `.changeset/` gave `24 passed (24)` and `914 passed (914)`.

## Gates at `c31dff6c1f`

objectui has no `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`. The families were derived by hand from the root `package.json` for this diff's paths (`packages/types/src/**`, one README, one changeset).

- `pnpm check:handler-key-reads`: exit 0, `OK  140 arm(s), 212 registration(s)`.
- `pnpm check:spec-symbols`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, `12 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
- `pnpm changeset:check`: exit 0, `No changeset declares a major bump`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0. A `grep -P` control-byte scan of the 13 changed files found 0.
- Exit 0 each: `check:changeset-claims` (report-only), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only; no row names these keys), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:esm-specifiers`, and `markdown-test-inputs --audit`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the 13 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint on the 11 changed TS files, `--no-inline-config --format json`: 11 files, 0 errors. All 37 warnings are `no-explicit-any` on lines this diff does not add (checked line by line against the diff). `--print-config` shows no `project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and an untouched file's verdict cannot move. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`. Its population collapsed (`packagesRead: found 3, floor is 25`) because the other packages' `dist` is not built in this worktree. That is a prerequisite, not a verdict. The README lines edited here carry no fenced block.

## Acceptance notes

- **The narrowings on already-published arms**, disclosed in the changeset. The tolerant face now refuses a spec-refused `responsiveStyles` value on the three arms, and `table.responsiveStyles` by name. The three TypeScript interfaces type the key as the spec's type, where it was `any` through the index signature. Level: `minor`, as the ruling set it; `check-changeset-no-major` forbids `major`.
- **The 18 producer nodes still do not validate on objectui's faces after this batch, for a reason outside this card's key.** The showcase writes them in the spec's page-component form, with props under `properties`. The three flat arms do not declare `properties`, so the strict face also refuses them by name. On the tolerant face the `object-grid` and `object-chart` nodes are refused too (`objectName` required; no chart family), because the arms read those keys at node level. `SchemaRenderer` hoists `properties` and renders the nodes, and the spec accepts them. This is reported to the seat as a finding, and is relevant to PR objectui#11069's un-park census.
- `object-chart`'s scope class lands on the chart container, not the `ObjectChart` root. A first probe on a node with no series binding drew the explanatory placeholder, and that placeholder did not carry the class.
- Downstream consumers' type-check is declared to CI's `Type Check`. Outside `packages/types`, no TypeScript source writes `responsiveStyles` on a node typed as one of these interfaces: the only hits are comments, `identity-probe` fixtures and `SchemaRenderer`'s own read. The one derived type, the `table` slot's `Pick`, is pinned by `object-view-slot-key-lists`.
- `origin/main` moved to `f4ed2387e9` (objectui#10188, objectui#11163) with zero file overlap with this branch, so it was not merged; the queue rebuilds on `main`.

## Deviations

- The fragment was renamed without being moved. The order tied the rename to a move, but the name would lie either way.
- The PR's reach is wider than the claim's file surface: `public-blocks.zod.ts` (rename only), `layout.ts` / `objectql.ts` (the twins, forced by the census), and two existing type-reading pins (forced). Each is listed above with its reason.
